segments.summary: Reviewed tool SSOT, provider and host authority boundaries, child-run identity, permission ownership, and GUI settings/usage visibility; found missing inclusive-design and user-visible state oracles.
Reviewed FileSafe sequencing, centralized policy, blocked lineage, side-effect identity, GUI scope, owner maps, and built-in registry; found unbound numbered-order and table acceptance references.
Reviewed debug metadata, edit grouping, provider aliases, LSP, shared envelopes, bash, and edit; found incomplete runtime payload, cancellation, and concurrent-mutation semantics.
Reviewed read, grep, glob, write, skill-runtime, question envelope, and card flow; found question-card accessibility, localization, reconnect, and concurrent-answer gaps.
Reviewed TODO schema/UI ownership and web dispatch, permission, input, and research recipes; found missing network, retry, cancellation, and partial-result recovery semantics.
Reviewed web activity, browser action safety, schema validation, formats, crawl/map, result envelopes, and Site Reader; found session-lifecycle, concurrency, partial-failure, and cleanup gaps.
Reviewed Site Reader product vocabulary, webfetch URL/cache/binary behavior, LSP expansion, chatsearch, codesearch, and grep ownership; found search-index retention, deletion, and revocation gaps.
Reviewed sparse n-gram extraction, query planning, freshness, filtering, GUI consumers, and performance publication; found benchmark-method and generation-publication recovery gaps.
